title: Rope Island
shortDescription: A willow island posted like a gate.
longDescription: A small island of willow roots holds a coil of rope and, if the sentry is still posted, a badger who means the painter to stay cut. North is the reed bank. East is the slip. South is the heron post.

fixtures.name: Rope Coil
fixtures.lookDescription: A coil of tarred rope. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: Collegium rope, coiled properly by somebody who knew how, which makes the theft worse rather than better. One end is cut flat. The willows here screen the whole channel, so anyone standing on this island can see the landing without being seen from it.
